description: Wire the Settings page (account, users, roles, wallet) to real API calls. Seed the database with the existing dummy data so the application works end-to-end without an empty screen. Depends on FEAT-002 (services must exist). Independent of FEAT-003.
steps:
Step 1 — Wire the Settings page (D:\Rasool\TaxSeerPractice\tax-filing-frontend-fuse-\src\app\views\taxseer\pages\settings\settings.ts).
  - Inject UserService, RoleService, WalletService.
  - Replace in-memory `users: User[]` array with `users: User[] = []`; load in constructor via userService.getAll().subscribe(data => this.users = data).
  - Replace in-memory `roles: Role[]` array with `roles: Role[] = []`; load via roleService.getAll().subscribe(data => this.roles = data).
  - Replace `walletBalance` (currently a hard-coded 100 in dashboard.ts top nav) with a load from walletService.getBalance(currentUserId).subscribe(b => this.walletBalance = b.balance). Pass the balance to the top nav via a shared signal or service.
  - saveUser(): after validation, call userService.create(userForm).subscribe(...) for invite, or userService.update(editingUser.id, userForm).subscribe(...) for edit.
  - removeUser(user): call userService.delete(user.id).subscribe(...).
  - resendInvite(user): call userService.resendInvite(user.id).subscribe(...).
  - saveRoles(): call roleService.update(role.id, {...}).subscribe(...) for each changed role.
  - DO NOT touch settings.html.

Step 2 — Create a DB seeder component for initial data. Create D:\Rasool\Project\TAXSEER\Taxseer-Backend\src\main\java\com\taxseer\config\DataSeeder.java as a @Component that implements ApplicationRunner. Annotate with @Profile('!test') so it doesn't run in test context. In the run() method, use all injected repositories to check if data already exists (if (filerRepository.count().block() > 0) return;) and if empty, save the seed filers, recipients, filings, and orders that match the dummy data in the frontend. Seed exactly: the 9 filers from TAXSEER_FILERS, their recipients from FILER_RECIPIENTS, key filings from FILER_FILINGS (about 10 representative ones), and the orders from TAXSEER_ORDERS. This provides a working demo without empty screens.

Step 3 — Wire the wallet balance display in the top nav. In D:\Rasool\TaxSeerPractice\tax-filing-frontend-fuse-\src\app\views\taxseer\layout\taxseer-top-nav.ts, inject WalletService and add a walletBalance signal. Load in constructor via walletService.getBalance(1).subscribe(w => this.walletBalance.set(w.balance)). In taxseer-top-nav.html, replace the hard-coded balance display with {{ walletBalance() }}. DO NOT touch taxseer-top-nav.scss.

Step 4 — Final integration build. Run `npm run build` from D:\Rasool\TaxSeerPractice\tax-filing-frontend-fuse- and `.\mvnw.cmd compile` from D:\Rasool\Project\TAXSEER\Taxseer-Backend. Both must succeed. Fix any remaining TypeScript or Java compilation errors.

Step 5 — Update FEAT status files. Set status to 'completed' in FEAT-001.json through FEAT-004.json. Record in each 'findings' field any important observations for the convergence reviewer (e.g., 'DataSeeder seeds 9 filers + 8 recipients + 10 filings + 9 orders on first boot').
acceptance_criteria: `npm run build` exits with no TypeScript errors
Settings page loads users and roles from API, not from hard-coded arrays
Wallet balance in top nav loads from API
DataSeeder.java exists and seeds the DB on first boot when tables are empty
No CSS, SCSS, or HTML files (except taxseer-top-nav.html for the balance binding) are modified
verification: Run `.\mvnw.cmd compile` from D:\Rasool\Project\TAXSEER\Taxseer-Backend — expect BUILD SUCCESS
Run `npm run build` from D:\Rasool\TaxSeerPractice\tax-filing-frontend-fuse- — expect zero TypeScript errors
Run backend with `.\mvnw.cmd spring-boot:run`, then `npm start` for frontend; navigate to http://localhost:4200/taxseer/dashboard — filers list populated from seeded DB data
findings: All steps completed and both builds pass. Key findings: (1) DataSeeder seeds 9 filers + 8 recipients + 10 representative filings + 9 orders + 4 roles + 4 users + 1 wallet on first boot (uses reactive non-blocking count check via filerRepository.count()). (2) settings.ts: users and roles arrays start empty and are populated via UserService.getAll() / RoleService.getAll() in the constructor; wallet balance loaded via WalletService.getBalance(1). (3) mapApiUser() handles both firstName/lastName (API) and first/last (legacy) field names. (4) mapApiRole() handles both comma-separated string and array permissions from the API. (5) saveRoles() calls roleService.update() for each non-locked role; grants are updated optimistically. (6) taxseer-top-nav.ts now injects WalletService and exposes walletBalance signal (default 100); taxseer-top-nav.html replaced hard-coded $100.00 with ${{ walletBalance() }}. (7) taxseer-top-nav.scss was NOT touched. (8) settings.html was NOT touched. (9) Both .mvnw.cmd compile and npm run build exit with success.
